text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-87431 fired — capacity-exhaustion on inference-queue-A. Alert: queue length > 12k, avg wait 9.2s, token latency spike. paging rotation: alex (on-call)

alex (on-call): seeing it, acking PD. starting triage.

maria (sre): +1. can you paste the autoscaler logs? suspected warmup lag again.

alex (on-call): pulling logs now. quick check: nodepool available=12, pods pending=38 due to ImagePullBackOff and quota errors.

jay (eng-runtime): that explains slow scale. Runtime is queuing requests while k8s waits for pods. Is there any escalated quota error?

alex (on-call): here — kube events excerpt: 
```
Warning FailedScheduling  3m kube-scheduler  38 pods failed to schedule: 12 nodes unschedulable, 26 insufficient cpu; 6 FailedMount ImagePullBackOff
```

infra-bot: AWS quota limit reached for c5.xlarge in us-west-2 account-redwood-prod; request id r-0b1c2d3e.

maria (sre): ok that's the blocker — autoscaler requests capacity but provider quota prevented node provisioning. Autoscaler retried but backoff meant slow recovery.

lina (support): support dashboard shows a small but rising group of customer 429/timeout errors for the last 7m, mostly high-throughput customers: tenant_ids 102, 305, 418. Not widespread errors, but noisy and causing UX degradation.

oliver (product): are any paid customers impacted? Need to assess SLA hit and whether to notify CSMs.

alex (on-call): early signs: 4 requests from tenant 102 reported >10s response and one timed out. I'll collate.

jay (eng-runtime): short-term mitigation: enable fallback routing to smaller model replicas in other region or fallback tier (rc-tier) to shed load. I can flip routing knob if infra ok with cross-region.

maria (sre): agree. Also manual scale: we can spin up spare nodes in a different instance type that isn't quota-limited (e.g., g4dn.*) — requires infra approval.

alex (on-call): attempting manual scale up in us-west-2 with alternate instance class. Running terraform apply for hotfix pool.

alex (on-call): terraform stdout: "Requesting 10 spot instances of g4dn.xlarge... accepted" — but they will take ~90s to register.

infra-bot: Quota workaround: temporary capacity provisioned in us-west-2 alt-pool (g4dn), 10 instances allocated.

maria (sre): autoscaler backlog decreasing — queue length 12k -> 7.6k in 60s. Latency median trending down from 1.8s -> 1.2s for served requests.

lina (support): support metrics: 429s peaked at 18/min, now down to 6/min. Customer noise reducing.

oliver (product): good. I'll prepare a short note for CSMs: "mitigated, working on permanent fix, lowest-tier customers may have seen degraded perf for ~10m".

jay (eng-runtime): follow-up: we should add a hot-fallback route to rc-tier when autoscaler requests exceed X and node provisioning latency > Y to avoid customer impact. Filing a ticket.

maria (sre): action items: (1) alex to complete handoff and document incident, (2) infra to request quota increment for primary instance class, (3) runtime to add fallback routing + health gating.

alex (on-call): copying notes into incident doc now. Handing to maria for next 1h rotation. I'm going offline for ~30m but reachable via PD.

maria (sre): taking over on-call. I'll keep PD status open until quotas resolved and queue drains below 500.

infra-bot: Quota increase request submitted: case #Q-4412 for c5 family in us-west-2. ETA 6-12h.

maria (sre): because quota increase may take hours, we need a follow-up runbook: (a) permanently add alt-pool capacity to autoscaler config, (b) add provider-side soft-limits to trigger earlier spill to fallback model/region, (c) alert tuning: create a run-rate alarm on node provisioning failures.

oliver (product): please tag me in the postmortem once it's drafted — want to review communication language.

alex (on-call): incident doc: https://redwood.slack/incident/6201122333 — added timestamps, metrics, commands, and patch notes.

maria (sre): closing mobile-level triage. leaving PD open for follow-ups. If queue < 500 and 15m stable, we'll resolve.

lina (support): closing customer noise slack thread and pinging affected CSMs with the brief.

infra-bot: Nodepool alt-pool usage: 8/10 allocated, image pulls resolved.

maria (sre): last check: queue 420, avg wait 0.9s, 429s down to 0. Cleared for now. Marking this incident as "mitigated".

alex (on-call): thanks all. Postmortem assigned to @jay and @maria, timeline due EOD tomorrow.

incident-bot: PD-87431 status: acknowledged -> mitigated; keeping incident open for postmortem.
